people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

people.name: Jotham
people.line: Youngest son of Gideon who escaped Abimelech's massacre

people.name: Shechem
people.line: City in Canaan, later allotted to Ephraim

translations.web: and God repaid all the wickedness of the men of Shechem on their heads; and the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal came on them.
translations.bsb: And God also brought all the wickedness of the men of Shechem back upon their own heads. So the curse of Jotham son of Jerubbaal came upon them.
translations.kjv: And all the evil of the men of Shechem did God render upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
translations.asv: and all the wickedness of the men of Shechem did God requite upon their heads: and upon them came the curse of Jotham the son of Jerubbaal.
